from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """Captures the raw financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company (e.g., 深圳市振业 (集团) 股份有限公司)")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company if available")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2025 Q1")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue in CNY (Numerator for score formula)")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit attributable to shareholders in CNY (Numerator for score formula)")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Operating Cash Flow Net in CNY (Numerator for score formula)")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets in CNY (Numerator for score formula)")
    shareholders_equity: float | None = Field(description="Shareholders Equity in CNY (Numerator for score formula)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all financial snapshots from the collection of documents."""
    company_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
